strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M3 native WBD session/control inside the locally qualified one-lane DTLS/FEC/FakeTCP path; M3A framing passed, M3B authentication state active
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Keep all M3 semantics inside an already-finished DTLS 1.3 association. Do not invent another cryptographic layer, reliable public byte stream or custom FEC. Do not start two-lane, kernel-anchor, TUN/L3, Windows, Auto or detector-specific shaping work before the M3 session/control gate passes. M3B should add only explicit authentication/session state after ACCEPT.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M3A on active branch through commit 50addb1fdd577528993bdce241a67cc98d45f5c9. A new carrier-agnostic internal/control package defines a fixed 8-byte WBDC envelope (magic, frame version, type, big-endian body length) with HELLO, ACCEPT and ERROR messages, protocol version 1 and strict 1024-byte body / 256-byte error-message bounds. It is deliberately separate from the rejected V1 DATA/ACK/GAP/TransmissionID wire format. Unit/table tests cover deterministic round trips, highest-common-version negotiation, unsupported-version ERROR, bad magic/version/type, truncation, trailing bytes, invalid HELLO ranges, oversized bodies/messages and invalid UTF-8; fuzz seeds and every-prefix truncation checks run without panic. A direct probe and reproducible qualification script were added. Local authority used the M2-qualified quiet DTLS shim SHA-256 63329b8528196159f430bb89bf40b98e52ed74073f57ed81d068cddb55e50d7a and the wbd.test certificate path: both DTLS peers reached READY as DTLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 before any control client was started; HELLO 1..1 returned ACCEPT 1 and HELLO 2..2 returned ERROR code 1 no-common-version. Local receipt result is pass. Source SHA-256 identities: control.go f862ac39b670ac9d4c5465c3521a4e549d80df1ff88244f1d3122cf7d70de1a5, control_test.go 98edffa33f1d98fba4f7db238b4d096f4ef08a9057484b86cb31b9686716be9d, probe 7eaece87dbe71933e44cd3590bb464f884288080c0ffc34c8d8d9186190c2ae4, qualification script 38bdbdcffb68efbeb912d120c42ad8cbb1885cfcdd31ba4cfe1b156876e13163, receipt c9fdcd624ffad5e2fdf5a0dee9dfa1faa9108ff4f147348aa06b2ad63f76008d. GitHub ci, handoff-verify and build-quic-oracle all completed successfully for 50addb1fdd577528993bdce241a67cc98d45f5c9.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M3B: add the smallest explicit post-ACCEPT session authentication state. Start with optional static bearer-token authentication carried only inside the existing DTLS application channel; unauthenticated sessions must not enter Established. Keep token handling independent of carrier/FEC and do not add password hashing, keepalive, reconnect or routing yet.
continuation_cursor.why_now: M3A established a strict versioned control boundary and proved it is exchanged only after DTLS Finished. The next product invariant is deciding when a WBD session is actually authorized to carry future application/L3 traffic. A tiny token-auth state machine can be tested independently before keepalive, reconnect and TUN semantics are layered on top.
continuation_cursor.done_when: M3B has explicit states for version negotiation, authentication-required and Established; AUTH and AUTH_OK/ERROR messages are bounded and strictly decoded; a configured static token is compared in constant time; missing/wrong tokens never enter Established; authentication-disabled mode may transition from ACCEPT directly to Established; duplicate/out-of-order AUTH/control messages are rejected deterministically; unit/malformed tests cover both modes; and a direct-DTLS loopback demonstrates correct-token success plus wrong-token rejection after M3A negotiation. No credentials are ever sent before DTLS READY/Finished.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M3B: extend the independent internal/control codec with bounded AUTH and AUTH_OK message types, then add a small server-side session state machine whose only policy input is optional expected bearer token. Use crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for configured-token comparison, reject AUTH before successful HELLO/ACCEPT and reject repeated AUTH after establishment. Write unit/state-machine tests first; then extend the direct DTLS probe to run auth-disabled success, correct-token success and wrong-token ERROR. Do not add username/password, keepalive, reconnect or TUN in this atomic step.
